# Xclator AI LLC

> Xclator AI LLC is a US-registered (Wyoming) AI product studio run by a lean, senior six-person team. We build and ship AI-powered SaaS products, and we build custom AI systems and software for clients. Our products are sold as one-time purchases with lifetime access.

- Website: https://www.xclator.com
- Contact: contact@xclator.com · +1 917 920 8834
- Address: 30 N Gould St, Ste 65282, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA

## Products

- [LeadHawk](https://www.xclator.com/products/leadhawk): AI-powered lead generation built for web designers & agencies. Finds businesses needing a website, audits weak sites, and delivers pitch-ready leads. Price: $1,200 lifetime. Live demo: https://leadhawk.xclator.com
- [ScribeFlow](https://www.xclator.com/products/scribeflow): AI transcription tool — paste any video link, get downloadable audio plus a 99% accurate, multilingual transcript exportable in any format. Price: $1,999 lifetime. Live demo: https://scribeflow.xclator.com
- [MapMotion](https://www.xclator.com/products/mapmotion): A 2D map animation tool for cinematic map sequences — flight routes, military movements, journeys — in minutes. Price: $699 lifetime. Live demo: https://mapmotion.xclator.com
- [Mobile ERP](https://www.xclator.com/products/mobile-erp): A lightweight, fully customizable ERP for mobile shops and small businesses — inventory, sales, and operations in one place. Price: $499 lifetime. Live demo: https://mobile.xclator.com
